periods.time: vol-16 ch-001, rainy-night flashback years before the main war

name.zh: 黑乃选择人类未来并退出KOK
name.en: Kurono chooses a human future and retires from KOK

periods.location: Rainy street under a streetlight in Japan
periods.summary: Nene confronts Kurono in the rain after hearing that Kurono will leave the KOK A-rank League before their long-awaited rematch. Kurono explains that while training she saw the Brute Soul gate and understood she could cross into the Desperado realm, but Takumi's arrival reminded her that her human fate had led her to love, marriage and pregnancy. She refuses to abandon that future or become someone who can no longer enjoy battle as before. Kurono apologizes to Nene, and Nene breaks down because the rival who had defined her path is choosing a life that will not cross hers again.
periods.cause: Kurono's impending marriage and pregnancy make her choose human destiny over Brute Soul and KOK competition.
periods.outcome: Kurono officially retires from KOK the next day; Nene inherits the ranking but loses the promised rematch that had driven her.
periods.significance: Establishes the emotional wound behind Nene's later temptation to surrender to Overdrive and her eventual realization that only Kurono, not Naseem, is the rival she truly wants to surpass.
